notes: Prospective single-centre study (2021-2022), single surgeon, 92 eyes of 82 patients; allocation by surgeon judgement and eye anatomy, not randomized. Mean follow-up was below 6 months in both groups (Table 1).

Tables 6 and 7 report each follow-up as a paired comparison within the subset of eyes measured at that visit, each with its own baseline. Each admissible mean pair is recorded as its own two-point series referenced to that subset's baseline. The two phaco-istent series come from different, overlapping subsets of the same 45-eye group.
Both arms are standard glaucoma procedures combined with phacoemulsification and no investigational agent; both are control.
